name: Harness — Regen With Chips Fixture
description: Minimal fixture for patch #13 (chip-congruence enforcement on regen). Reproduces the in-company-match production bug verbatim: the regen post-walk lands on an aiQuestion with `inlineOptions` of decision-role chips ([RH/L&D, Gestor, C-level, Comprador]); without the override the LLM frequently asked num_pessoas with role chips below — incongruent. The test asserts the regen system text inlines the 4 chip labels + the imperative "MUST be congruent / DEVE ser congruente".
triggerDescription: Harness-only fixture — NEVER auto-triggered by the router. Tests must force this flow via flowId.
